title: Marine / free-surface capability
solver: OpenFOAM v2606 interFoam (VOF, laminar), native, no Docker

navyfoam_decision.reason: gated behind HPCMP CREATE-SH, DoD-aligned account, 1-2 week approval

ladder.name: Dam break vs Martin & Moyce (1952)
ladder.gate: fail (R1 2026-07-30: +8.2% mean / +11.0% max vs declared 5% tolerance; was +13.6%/+21.3%)

config.domain: 15a wide x 2a tall x thin single-cell slab (2D, empty front/back)

nondimensionalisation.source: arXiv:2108.08769 (Xie 2021), Sec 3.3.2 / Fig 7, verified against page image not just text extraction

reference_data.source: Martin & Moyce (1952), original tabulated data not located; digitised from Fig. 7 of arXiv:2108.08769 (Xie 2021) which plots the 1952 experimental points
reference_data.digitisation_method: programmatic pixel-position detection (axis-tick pixel clusters for calibration, cross-marker centroid detection), not manual eyeballing

feasibility_evidence.solver_completion: reached endTime=0.8s (T~10.5) on all 3 runs, no divergence, no FPE
feasibility_evidence.alpha_boundedness: within MULES numerical tolerance (~1e-6), no unbounded blow-up

gate_result.primary_metric: surge front position Z vs nondimensional time T

comparison.note: confounded by proximity to domain far wall (15a)

coarse_mesh_same_metric.note: sign flipped vs medium mesh -- refinement did NOT converge toward reference, ruling out simple under-resolution as sole cause

bc_control_test.hypothesis: open-top atmosphere BC lets air vent too easily, over-speeding the front vs the reference paper's fully closed box
bc_control_test.result: REFUTED -- closed-box rerun gave essentially identical front trajectory to open-top run

comparison.note: near edge of digitised reference range

secondary_check.interpretation: bulk column depletion tracks the reference much more closely than the leading-edge front position

cause: Not a boundary-condition artifact (ruled out by closed-box vs open-top A/B test)
Not simple under-resolution (mesh refinement flipped the sign of the error rather than converging)
Correlated with near-wall sampling height used to define front position from the discretised VOF field; the leading edge is thin and not vertical at these resolutions
Bulk quantity (column height decay), less sensitive to this effect, agrees with reference to within ~10%
lesson: A single alpha=0.5 crossing at the first cell above the floor is not a mesh-independent front-position definition for VOF dam-break validation; needs either a genuine multi-mesh Richardson study or an isosurface-based front extraction
Programmatic pixel-position digitisation (axis-tick calibration + marker centroid detection) of a published figure is more reliable than eyeballing and should be the default method going forward
Gate failed as measured; shipped as a documented failure per campaign hard rules

r1_audit_2026_07_30.scope: L-22-style audit of the NOT_PASSING_REGISTER F7a entry, then diagnosis, fix attempt, and grading
r1_audit_2026_07_30.l22_applicability: convergence/accuracy entry - explicitly exempt from L-22's primary-evidence citation rule; audited on substance anyway. Register Evidence line pointed only at CAMPAIGN_STATUS.md (secondary); case's own log.interFoam now cited.
confirmed: recorded +13.6% mean / +21.3% max reproduce from the case's own log.interFoam and alpha.water dumps
log.interFoam: 1133 timesteps, clean End, ExecutionTime 17.89 s, phase-1 volume fraction constant 0.0333333
reference digitisation independently reproduced at 600 dpi to <=0.01 in T and <=0.005 in Z
non-dimensionalisation T=t*sqrt(g/a), Z=x/a re-read verbatim from arXiv:2108.08769 Sec 3.3.2

retracted.claim: coarse mesh dx=a/8 undershoots -13.2%, sign-flipped vs medium; refinement flipped sign rather than converging
retracted.why: artifact of the near-floor alpha=0.5 line probe, whose absolute sampling height moves with the mesh. Under one consistent depth-integrated metric the a/8 rung overshoots by +11.8%, same sign as every other rung.

retracted.claim: root cause: VOF numerical smearing of the thin leading edge / VOF interface-definition limitation
retracted.why: the metric is threshold-convergent (0.24% spread over thresholds 0.01a-0.04a at dx=dy=a/64) and refinement improves the deviation monotonically from a/16 down

retracted.claim: D2: interface compression cAlpha is a confirmed material contributor, ~40% error reduction
retracted.why: the effect reverses sign with the metric; under the depth-integrated metric cAlpha=0 makes the deviation worse (+13.5% -> +16.8%)

max_courant.note: 0.52 was the final timestep's value, not the maximum over the run

reference_simulation_comparator.source: same Fig. 7, paper's own inviscid simulation curve, digitised in R1 (nobody had extracted it before)
reference_simulation_comparator.model: inviscid, no turbulence, no surface tension, no interface compression; 240x20 cells (dx=dy=a/16)
reference_simulation_comparator.note: establishes the achievable standard on this benchmark: -4.3% to +1.8%

front_metric.definition: depth-integrated water height h(x)=sum(alpha*dy); front where h drops through k*a

wall_normal_ladder_dx_a_over_32.note_a256: early-time outlier at T=3.90 (+18.1%) inflates its mean; from T=5.17 it is the closest case run (+8.7% mean)
wall_normal_ladder_dx_a_over_32.asymptotic_note: successive steps -3.9, -2.3, -2.1 percentage points: shrinking but not geometrically; no extrapolated limit quoted

single_variable_tests_at_a_over_16.verdict: no numerical knob helps; all four make it worse

mechanism.name: under-resolved bed friction beneath the sub-millimetre leading film
mechanism.evidence: velocity profile at Z=11, T=8.52: at dy=a/128 no-slip, U_x rises 0.359 -> 1.049 m/s over five cells (boundary layer fills ~60% of the 2.9 mm film); the identical mesh with a slip floor is plug flow at 1.047 m/s; at dy=a/32 the film is two cells and the wall gradient is under-predicted ~40% (999 vs 1607 1/s, tau_w ~1.0 vs 1.61 Pa)
mechanism.proof: slip/no-slip control at matched fine mesh undoes the entire refinement gain

grading.verdict: GATE FAIL - deviation roughly halved but still above tolerance

r1_audit_2026_07_30.counter_signal: resolving bed friction improves the front and degrades the column height (+3.5% -> +4.2% -> +6.4% over all 8 points as dy goes a/64 -> a/128 -> a/256); the experiment sits between, so the residual is not a single missing friction term
open: transitional bed friction (film Re ~ 3e3, runs laminar)
1952 gate-withdrawal time unknown (original paper not open access)
reference simulation's own front definition unstated
r1_audit_2026_07_30.mpi_ranks_used: 1-8 (exceeds the top-level process_caps.max_mpi_ranks=4 recorded for the original pass; load checked before each launch)
